title: Interactive Button
description: Add a button to the HUD that prints a message when clicked.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Handle button click events.

1. Open `WBP_SimpleHUD` (or create a new one).
2. Drag a **Button** widget onto the Canvas. Inside it, place a **Text Block** labeled "Click Me".
3. Select the Button. In the Details panel, under Events, click **+** next to **OnClicked**.
4. In the Graph, from the OnClicked node, add a **Print String** node with the message "Button Clicked!"
5. Compile and ensure the widget is added to the viewport.
6. Play. Click the button (mouse cursor must be visible; use Set Input Mode Game and UI or UI Only).

**Expect:** Message appears on screen when the button is clicked.
hints: If you can't click, add a 'Set Input Mode Game and UI' node in the Player Controller and set 'Show Mouse Cursor' to true.
You may need to add a Player Controller Blueprint if using a blank project.
expectedOutput: Button click triggers a print message.
